lines.en: Into the headwind I beat a little slower.
Higher up, the grass can't scrape me.
I ride the savanna wind.

lines.zh: 草原的风，把我托得很稳。
lines.en: Savanna wind holds me steady.
This warm updraft holds my wings.
I'll cover some nest-ward miles in the dark.
Up high there are no grass barbs.
The base of my wings aches; I need a rest.
I'll loop the acacias back to my nest.
I cross that thorn patch from above.
Fewer beats, save some strength.

lines.zh: 草原上飞低些，草籽好吃。
lines.en: Fly low on the savanna — the seeds are good.
Clouds gone; the sun bakes my wings.
The wind shifted; I change course.

lines.zh: 草原的干风，把我的翅吹硬了。
lines.en: The dry savanna wind stiffens my wings.
Too many branches; I fold my wings through.

lines.zh: 草原上的翅膀，靠风才轻。
lines.en: Wings on the savanna are light only in wind.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，草原的翅膜晒热了。
lines.en: Rest a moment; the savanna sun warmed my wings.

lines.zh: 草原就这点好，风一直有。
lines.en: One good thing here: the wind never stops.
woods has this one perk.
Someone is moving down there.
I forgot the name of that nectar.

lines.zh: 草原上的旱季，我照样飞。
lines.en: Even in the savanna's dry season I fly.

lines.zh: 翅缘的锯齿，是吓鸟用的。
lines.en: The jagged wing edge scares birds.
The grass is still; my wings too.
Too hot on the savanna to flap.
The sun is slanting; time to fold my wings.
Perched on a flower, I doze a while.
Your face is bigger than any flower.
That acacia is mine.

lines.zh: 草原上你抬头，我就落在草尖。
lines.en: You look up, and I settle on a grass tip.
I circle over your head for a clear look.
I know the smell of dry savanna grass.
Can you even reach my wings?

lines.zh: 我翅上的锯齿，飞得很快。
lines.en: With jagged wings, I fly fast.
Your sleeve smells of grass seed.
Two-legged ones. I've seen your kind.
Thermals carry me high.
My wing's knocked crooked. It hurts.
A hole in my wing membrane makes me fly crooked.
Lost a handful of wing scales… ow.
One wing still beats.
You touched my wing.
A torn wing corner — I still fly.
Next time I come from behind.
Wing dust drifts to the ground.
I'm spiraling; I can't catch the air.
Wings folded, I rise to higher ground.

lines.zh: 草原的太阳，把我的翅晒得发亮。
lines.en: Savanna sun polished my wings bright.

lines.zh: 你口袋里的甜味，飘过来了。
lines.en: The sweetness in your pocket drifted over.
Savanna flowers bloom faster than I fly.

lines.zh: 草原上，我跟着你的影子。
lines.en: On the savanna, I follow your shadow.

lines.zh: 我闻到草原花蜜的香味。
lines.en: I smell savanna nectar on the air.
Is there more of that flower in your bag?
Slow down, my wings can't keep up.
I'll settle first, then decide.
Give me the petal and I'll perch on your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道，正是我要找的那朵。
lines.en: This is the very flower I was seeking.
You knocked the scales off my wings.
The wind has wrung my wings.
The serrations on my wing got blunted!
You're standing in my flight line.
In the sky, you're the only one I dodge.

lines.zh: 翅上一道白带，掠得很快。
lines.en: A white band on my wing, sweeping past.
A walking wall. Don't squeeze my wings.
Where did that arc I was flying go?
You looked up and I nearly dropped.
The savanna wind shoved me off course.
On a savanna bloom, I wait for you.
I caught a bug, for you.
Land on this grass tip beside me.
Land on the same blade of grass as me.
I've waited through a whole season of dry wind.
The savanna has only a few flowers.
That white band — you recognize it?

lines.zh: 我的花纹，是给同伴看的。
lines.en: My pattern is for my own kind.
The pattern on my wings looks like bark.
You beat twice, I beat twice.

lines.zh: 又一件收藏品，进我囊里。
lines.en: Another collectible for my pouch.
If I drop it, don't blame me.
Taking this back to show the others.
This petal goes back to the nest.
I'll wedge it in a bark crevice.
My nest floor needs another layer.
This shape won't sit on my head.
So light it costs me nothing to hold.
Picked from the grass. Mine.

lines.zh: 草原上我飞得又直又快。
lines.en: Over the savanna I fly fast and straight.
I climb above the grass tips first.
Your nectar smell gave you away.
The wind dies; my wings press down.
My wingtip is already lined on you.
The savanna is bare; nowhere to hide.
Hungry enough that my wings feel heavy.
The edges of my wings are serrated.
Acacia thorns have shielded me before.
Wings folded, ready to drop.
The savanna wind pushes at my back.
The hole is too narrow for you.
You looked up. Saves me the search.
I fly fast. You cannot catch me.
One pant and I know where you are.
Diving into the wind costs me too much.
Skimming the grass tips, you can't hide.

lines.zh: 草原的金合欢，我绕着飞。
lines.en: I circle the savanna's acacias.
The grass isn't that deep.
I'll swing downwind of you first.
That thorn thicket is a dead end.
Move, or you get the horns too.
Wings shut; I slam into your face.

lines.zh: 我落在兽背上，喝一口就走。
lines.en: I land on a beast's back, sip, and go.
My mouth is full of your hair.
Wings snap shut. Charging!

lines.zh: 我翅缘的锯齿，勾住你了。
lines.en: The serrations on my wing edge have you.
My serrated wing snags your hem.
One jab. Stop swinging.

lines.zh: 我从高原的风里落下来了。
lines.en: I drop out of the plateau wind.
The barbs on my wing edge cut deep.
Wings dried. Time to fly.
The wind carried me here.
First wind since I left the chrysalis.
Which way to the acacias?
The membrane's dry. I can move.
Bad landing. One more beat.
I've looked all over and found no flowers.
The dew's still on. Dawn just broke.
This grass smells strange. Where am I?
The night wind's cold — I'll settle for now.
The flames licked my wings.
Can't right myself. My wings are shaking.
Water glues my wings shut.
The blast flipped my wings over.
The arrow went through my wing membrane.
My wings numb. This isn't wind.

lines.zh: 稀树草原的花，一朵也没开。
lines.en: Not one flower has opened on this savanna.
Lightning numbed my wing membrane.
My wings are gone. Nothing to beat.
